title_en: China Development Bank, Henan Branch — Application for Enforcement Supervision
ruling_gist_en: Where a person subject to enforcement who has entered bankruptcy reorganization proceedings fails to notify a creditor who has already entered enforcement proceedings to declare claims, thereby causing the creditor to lose the opportunity to assert claims in the bankruptcy reorganization proceedings, after the reorganization plan has been executed, the creditor has the right, in accordance with Article 92 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the PRC, to exercise rights in accordance with the conditions for repayment of claims of the same category as stipulated in the bankruptcy reorganization plan, and to apply for resumption of enforcement.

full_text_en:
Application for Enforcement Supervision by the Henan Branch of the National Development Bank of China

【Ruling Gist】

A person subject to enforcement that has entered into bankruptcy reorganization proceedings fails to notify a creditor who had previously entered into enforcement proceedings to file its claims, resulting in the creditor losing the opportunity to assert its claims in the bankruptcy reorganization proceedings. After the reorganization plan has been fully implemented, the creditor has the right, in accordance with Article 92 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China, to exercise its rights under the repayment conditions for similar claims as specified in the bankruptcy reorganization plan and apply for resumption of enforcement.

Supreme People's Court Enforcement Ruling

(2022) Zui Gao Fa Zhi Jian No. 121

Petitioner (Reconsideration Applicant, Enforcement Applicant): Henan Branch of the National Development Bank of China. Domicile: No. 266 Jinshui Road, Jinshui District, Zhengzhou City, Henan Province.

Principal: Ma Dongqi, President of the Branch.

Agent ad litem: Yang Likai, lawyer of Henan Mingshang Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Zhu Ke, lawyer of Henan Mingshang Law Firm.

Person subject to enforcement: Lotus Health Industry Group Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 18 Lotus Avenue, Xiangcheng City, Henan Province.

Legal Representative: Li Houwen, Chairman of the Company.

Person subject to enforcement: Henan Lotus MSG Group Co., Ltd. Domicile: No. 18 Lotus Avenue, Xiangcheng City, Henan Province.

Legal Representative: Guo Jian, Chairman of the Company.

Petitioner, the Henan Branch of the National Development Bank of China (hereinafter referred to as CDB Henan Branch), being dissatisfied with the Enforcement Ruling (2021) Yu Zhi Fu No. 339 of the Henan High People's Court (hereinafter referred to as Henan High Court), filed a petition to this Court. After accepting the case, this Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law to examine the case, and the examination of this case has now concluded.

In the case of resuming enforcement of the loan guarantee contract dispute between the CDB Henan Branch and Lotus Health Industry Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Lotus Health Company) and Henan Lotus MSG Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Lotus Group), the Zhoukou Intermediate People's Court of Henan Province (hereinafter referred to as Zhoukou Intermediate Court) issued an Enforcement Notice on March 11, 2021, (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20. Lotus Health Company, being dissatisfied with the resumption of enforcement, filed an enforcement objection to Zhoukou Intermediate Court, requesting the revocation of the Enforcement Notice (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20 and the termination of the enforcement proceedings.

Facts and reasons: (1) Lotus Health Company and CDB Henan Branch have reached an enforcement settlement regarding the repayment of the debt, and the creditor-debtor relationship has been extinguished. (2) Given that Lotus Health Company has already undergone bankruptcy reorganization under the auspices of Zhoukou Intermediate Court on October 15, 2019, even if CDB Henan Branch holds a claim against Lotus Health Company, it should assert its rights by participating in the reorganization proceedings and filing its claim, obtain confirmation in accordance with the law, and receive fair repayment uniformly according to the reorganization plan.

Zhoukou Intermediate Court found: In the case of the loan contract dispute between CDB Henan Branch and Lotus Health Company (formerly Henan Lotus MSG Co., Ltd.) and Lotus Group, Zhoukou Intermediate Court rendered a civil judgment on December 8, 2006, (2006) Zhou Min Chu Zi No. 107, adjudicating that Lotus Health Company shall repay CDB Henan Branch the loan principal of RMB 99,577,909.47 and interest of RMB 1,349,727.03, and pay liquidated damages of RMB 759,276.36 (interest and liquidated damages calculated up to September 20, 2006; thereafter, interest shall be calculated according to the loan interest rate prescribed by the People's Bank of China, and liquidated damages shall be calculated according to the agreement in the loan contract between the parties, and shall be paid together until the date of repayment); Lotus Group shall bear joint and several liability for the debts owed by Lotus Health Company, and Lotus Group shall pay CDB Henan Branch liquidated damages of RMB 1,138,914.54 (calculated up to September 20, 2006). Thereafter, upon application by CDB Henan Branch, Zhoukou Intermediate Court initiated enforcement; on December 24, 2009, Zhoukou Intermediate Court issued a ruling (2007) Zhou Fa Zhi Zi No. 46-8, adjudicating that the enforcement proceedings in this case be closed. Subsequently, CDB Henan Branch applied for resumption of enforcement, and Zhoukou Intermediate Court opened a case on March 11, 2021, and issued a Resumption of Enforcement Notice on March 22, 2021, (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20, resuming the enforcement of the civil judgment (2006) Zhou Min Chu Zi No. 107. Lotus Health Company, being dissatisfied with the resumption of enforcement notice, raised the aforementioned objection.

Zhoukou Intermediate Court further found: On September 1, 2009, CDB Henan Branch sent a letter to the People's Government of Zhoukou City, "Letter on the Proposed Application for Bankruptcy Proceedings against Henan Lotus MSG Co., Ltd." (Kai Hang Yu Han [2009] No. 62). On October 19, 2009, the People's Government of Zhoukou City replied with "Reply Letter on the Proposed Application for Bankruptcy Proceedings by the National Development Bank against Lotus Co., Ltd." (Zhou Zheng Han [2009] No. 24), stating: "After research at the municipal government office meeting, our city plans to coordinate with Lotus Co., Ltd. and relevant units to raise RMB 30 million for repayment of your bank's loan, and recommends that your bank write off the remaining loan principal and interest." In December, the People's Government of Zhoukou City contributed RMB 15 million, and Lotus Health Company contributed RMB 15 million, totaling RMB 30 million paid to CDB Henan Branch, and CDB Henan Branch wrote off the remaining loan principal and interest. On October 30, 2012, the proposal at the 15th meeting of the Fifth Board of Directors of Lotus Health Company announced: "Under the coordination of the People's Government of Zhoukou City, the parties reached an enforcement settlement, and Zhoukou Intermediate Court issued a ruling in 2009, adjudicating the closure of the enforcement proceedings in this case. After the closure of this case, the National Development Bank has canceled this loan in the company's loan card information, and the company has no such debt by checking the loan card information. The creditor-debtor relationship in this case has in fact been extinguished." The proposal was unanimously approved.

Zhoukou Intermediate Court further found: On October 15, 2019, Zhoukou Intermediate Court issued a civil ruling (2019) Yu 16 Po Shen No. 7, ruling to accept the reorganization application filed by Guohou Asset Management Co., Ltd. against Lotus Health Company. On December 16, 2019, Zhoukou Intermediate Court issued a civil ruling (2019) Yu 16 Po No. 7-2, ruling to approve the reorganization plan of Lotus Health Company and terminate the reorganization proceedings of Lotus Health Company.

Zhoukou Intermediate Court held that, pursuant to Articles 19 and 92 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China, Zhoukou Intermediate Court ruled on October 15, 2019 to accept the reorganization application against Lotus Health Company, and on December 16, 2019 ruled to approve the reorganization plan of Lotus Health Company, after which Lotus Health Company entered the period of implementation of the reorganization plan. CDB Henan Branch did not file its claim during the reorganization period of Lotus Health Company, and now seeks to assert its claim. The approach to exercise this right should be to determine the amount of repayment by filing a claim and obtain repayment. Currently, directly applying for resumption of enforcement after the reorganization of Lotus Health Company is inconsistent with the provisions of the "Reorganization Plan of Lotus Health Industry Group Co., Ltd." (hereinafter referred to as the "Reorganization Plan"), and the right claimed by CDB Henan Branch should not be determined in the enforcement and enforcement objection proceedings. Therefore, directly resuming enforcement is not appropriate, and the objection request of Lotus Health Company is justified. After deliberation by the Adjudication Committee of the court, Zhoukou Intermediate Court issued a ruling on April 21, 2021, (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Yi No. 40, revoking the Resumption of Enforcement Notice (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20 of Zhoukou Intermediate Court.

CDB Henan Branch, being dissatisfied with the above objection ruling, applied for reconsideration to Henan High Court, requesting the revocation of Zhoukou Intermediate Court's ruling (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Yi No. 40, the dismissal of Lotus Health Company's enforcement objection, and the continuation of enforcement in case (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20. Facts and reasons: (1) The ruling of Zhoukou Intermediate Court would result in CDB Henan Branch having no way to realize its creditor's rights, causing huge loss of state-owned assets. Lotus Health Company still owes CDB Henan Branch a loan principal of nearly RMB 70 million plus interest, and according to the repayment ratio in the Reorganization Plan, it still needs to repay more than RMB 37 million. Although the ruling of Zhoukou Intermediate Court mentioned that CDB Henan Branch should determine the amount of repayment in accordance with the relevant provisions for unclaimed claims in the Reorganization Plan of Lotus Health Company and obtain repayment, the reorganization proceedings have ended and no further claims can be filed, so the ruling is not enforceable. (2) Zhoukou Intermediate Court's ruling that the way for CDB Henan Branch to assert its claim should not be through resumption of enforcement is clearly erroneous. The claim of CDB Henan Branch has been confirmed by an effective judgment and has entered enforcement proceedings. The bankruptcy reorganization proceedings of Lotus Health Company have concluded. As a known creditor, CDB Henan Branch failed to file its claim within the filing period because Zhoukou Intermediate Court did not notify it of the bankruptcy reorganization and claim filing matters. According to the relevant contents of the Reorganization Plan, the claim in this case should be repaid by Lotus Health Company with funds from subsequent production and operations at the repayment rate specified in the Reorganization Plan. (3) In this case, CDB Henan Branch followed the procedures for write-off, and there is no situation of extinguishment of the creditor-debtor relationship. CDB Henan Branch still enjoys the lawful rights and interests of the written-off claim in this case and has the right to apply to the court for resumption of enforcement.

The facts found by Henan High Court are basically consistent with those found by Zhoukou Intermediate Court.

Henan High Court further found: The Reorganization Plan stipulates: "IV(2)4. Ordinary claims. After ordinary claims are confirmed by the ruling of Zhoukou Intermediate Court, they shall be repaid according to the following time limits and methods: (1) For the part of each ordinary creditor's claim up to RMB 100,000 (including RMB 100,000), Lotus Health Company shall repay it in cash within the implementation period of this reorganization plan; (2) For the part of each ordinary creditor's claim exceeding RMB 100,000, Lotus Health Company shall repay it in cash within the implementation period of this reorganization plan at a repayment ratio of 17.48%."; "IV(3)2. Unfiled claims. For claims recorded in the books of Lotus Health Company but not filed in accordance with the law, if the creditor's rights should be protected by law, they may not be exercised during the implementation period of this reorganization plan, but after the implementation of the reorganization plan is completed, Lotus Health Company may be required to repay them in accordance with the repayment scheme for similar claims as stipulated in the reorganization plan."; "VI(1) The implementation period of this reorganization plan shall be calculated from the date when the reorganization plan is approved by the ruling of Zhoukou Intermediate Court. Lotus Health Company shall complete the implementation of the reorganization plan by April 30, 2020. During this period, Lotus Health Company shall strictly repay debts in accordance with the provisions of the reorganization plan and pay reorganization expenses at any time."; "VIII(5)3. For unfiled claims, no debt repayment funds shall be set aside in this reorganization plan. After the relevant claims are confirmed by Zhoukou Intermediate Court, based on the finally confirmed amount of the claim, Lotus Health Company shall repay them with funds from subsequent production and operations at the repayment rate specified in this reorganization plan."

Henan High Court held that the focus of this case is whether CDB Henan Branch's request to continue enforcement in case (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20 should be supported. Article 19 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China stipulates: "After the people's court accepts an application for bankruptcy, preservation measures against the debtor's property shall be lifted, and enforcement proceedings shall be suspended." Article 92 stipulates: "A reorganization plan approved by the people's court's ruling is binding on the debtor and all creditors. A creditor that fails to file its claim in accordance with this Law may not exercise its rights during the implementation period of the reorganization plan; after the implementation of the reorganization plan is completed, it may exercise its rights in accordance with the repayment conditions for similar claims specified in the reorganization plan. The rights enjoyed by a creditor against the debtor's guarantor and other joint and several debtors shall not be affected by the reorganization plan." In this case, Zhoukou Intermediate Court had already ruled on October 15, 2019 to accept the reorganization application against Lotus Health Company, and on December 16, 2019 ruled to approve the reorganization plan of Lotus Health Company. After that, Lotus Health Company entered the implementation period of the reorganization plan, and the reorganization plan was implemented by April 30, 2020. CDB Henan Branch did not file its claim during the reorganization period of Lotus Health Company, and now seeks to assert its claim. It should, in accordance with the Reorganization Plan and the relief channels provided by relevant bankruptcy laws, exercise its rights through statutory procedures such as filing a claim with Lotus Health Company, its administrator, or Zhoukou Intermediate Court and other statutory entities, so as to determine its status as a bankruptcy creditor and the amount of repayment and obtain repayment. Its argument that it failed to file its claim within the filing period because Zhoukou Intermediate Court did not notify it of the bankruptcy reorganization and claim filing matters should also be asserted through the above channels, which are not within the scope of review in objection and reconsideration cases. CDB Henan Branch's application for resumption of enforcement after the implementation of the Reorganization Plan of Lotus Health Company to assert its claim by way of individual repayment is inconsistent with the provisions of the bankruptcy reorganization plan and also contradicts the principle of fairness set forth in China's bankruptcy legal system. CDB Henan Branch's request to continue enforcement in case (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20 has no factual and legal basis and should not be supported. Zhoukou Intermediate Court's objection ruling revoking its Resumption of Enforcement Notice (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20 was not improper. Accordingly, Henan High Court issued an enforcement ruling (2021) Yu Zhi Fu No. 339, dismissing the reconsideration application of CDB Henan Branch and maintaining the objection ruling (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Yi No. 40 of Zhoukou Intermediate Court.

CDB Henan Branch, being dissatisfied with the enforcement ruling (2021) Yu Zhi Fu No. 339 of Henan High Court, filed a petition to this Court, requesting: 1. Revocation of the enforcement ruling (2021) Yu Zhi Fu No. 339 of Henan High Court and the enforcement ruling (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Yi No. 40 of Zhoukou Intermediate Court. 2. Maintenance of the Resumption of Enforcement Notice (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20 of Zhoukou Intermediate Court, and that Zhoukou Intermediate Court continue enforcement of the civil judgment (2006) Zhou Min Chu Zi No. 107, compelling the person subject to enforcement, Lotus Health Company, to repay the claim to CDB Henan Branch in accordance with the repayment plan approved in its Reorganization Plan, and that the person subject to enforcement, Lotus Group, continue to repay CDB Henan Branch for all debts under the civil judgment (2006) Zhou Min Chu Zi No. 107. Facts and reasons: (1) Since both Henan High Court and Zhoukou Intermediate Court ruled that this case should not be resolved through resumption of enforcement proceedings, and Lotus Health Company has not repaid the claim to CDB Henan Branch in accordance with the repayment conditions specified in the Reorganization Plan, CDB Henan Branch currently has no effective legal remedy to assert its lawful rights, and the claim confirmed by effective judgments and rulings cannot be realized. In April and June 2021, CDB Henan Branch sent a "Notice of Request to Participate in Lotus Bankruptcy Reorganization Distribution" to Lotus Health Company and its administrator. The administrator replied to CDB Henan Branch on June 18, 2021, stating that Zhoukou Intermediate Court had ruled to terminate the reorganization proceedings of Lotus Health Company, the administrator's supervision duties had ceased, and informed CDB Henan Branch to file a claim with Lotus Health Company. On June 21, 2021, Lotus Health Company informed CDB Henan Branch's staff of the filing materials via WeChat. On July 12, 2021, CDB Henan Branch filed a claim with Lotus Health Company in the format required by Lotus Health Company, but Lotus Health Company has not yet repaid the claim to CDB Henan Branch in accordance with the repayment conditions set forth in its Reorganization Plan, and the financial claim of CDB Henan Branch has not been repaid to date. (2) The procedural issue involved in this case is how should unclaimed claims after the conclusion of reorganization proceedings exercise their rights in accordance with the Reorganization Plan? Since the law has no clear provision on this, CDB Henan Branch believes that the resumption of enforcement of this case by Zhoukou Intermediate Court is the most beneficial solution for all parties and maximizes the conservation of judicial resources. During the reorganization of Lotus Health Company, it was because Lotus Health Company did not list CDB Henan Branch as a creditor in the debt schedule, and CDB Henan Branch has no fault for the unclaimed claim. The Reorganization Plan of Lotus Health Company has been approved by Zhoukou Intermediate Court's ruling, and the Reorganization Plan clearly stipulates that unclaimed claims shall be repaid by Lotus Health Company with funds from subsequent production and operations at the repayment rate specified in the reorganization plan. Receiving repayment in enforcement proceedings at the ratio determined in the Reorganization Plan will not harm the lawful rights and interests of other creditors. The law does not clearly require that procedures such as re-initiating claim filing, convening creditors' meetings, re-examining claims, etc., must be initiated to handle unclaimed claims. After the reorganization proceedings have concluded, re-initiating relevant procedures would also unnecessarily increase the burden on all parties. The law also does not prohibit creditors from applying to the enforcement court for continued enforcement in accordance with the repayment conditions for similar claims determined in the reorganization plan after the reorganization proceedings have concluded. (3) If CDB Henan Branch files a separate lawsuit, the accepting court will still be Zhoukou Intermediate Court, and CDB Henan Branch may face the risk of the lawsuit being dismissed or not being accepted due to violation of the principle of non bis in idem. Even if Zhoukou Intermediate Court accepts the case, it would need to re-confirm the claim that has already been confirmed in the trial and enforcement proceedings of that court. After filing a lawsuit, CDB Henan Branch may also go through first instance, second instance, and even retrial proceedings, and eventually it will be transferred back to Zhoukou Intermediate Court for enforcement. Such a circular litigation in the same court only to confirm a simple mathematical formula—that the amount of the claim to be repaid by Lotus Health Company equals the claim of CDB Henan Branch under Zhoukou Intermediate Court's No. 107 judgment calculated up to October 15, 2019, the date of the reorganization of Lotus Health Company, multiplied by the repayment ratio determined in Lotus Health Company's Reorganization Plan—would undoubtedly greatly waste judicial resources and increase the burden on all parties to the litigation. (4) The substantive issue involved in this case is whether CDB Henan Branch's write-off of the claim means that Lotus Health Company is not required to bear liability for repayment? CDB Henan Branch has never waived its claim against Lotus Health Company. The ruling (2007) Zhou Fa Zhi Zi No. 46-8 of Zhoukou Intermediate Court was a closure of the current enforcement proceedings, and it clearly stated that if CDB Henan Branch discovers that the person subject to enforcement has property available for enforcement, it may apply to the court again for enforcement. (5) In this case, besides Lotus Health Company, there is also another person subject to enforcement, Lotus Group. Zhoukou Intermediate Court, solely on the ground that CDB Henan Branch should not resume enforcement after the reorganization of Lotus Health Company, directly terminated the case's resumption enforcement proceedings by enforcement ruling (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20 and revoked the Resumption of Enforcement Notice (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20, which clearly deprived CDB Henan Branch of its right to demand repayment from the other person subject to enforcement, Lotus Group, and should be corrected.

This Court confirms the facts found by Zhoukou Intermediate Court and Henan High Court.

This Court further finds: In the bankruptcy reorganization proceedings of this case, Lotus Health Company did not notify CDB Henan Branch of its entry into bankruptcy proceedings, which resulted in CDB Henan Branch not filing its claim in the bankruptcy reorganization proceedings of Lotus Health Company.

2021年6月11日，国开行河南省分行向莲花健康公司发出《要求参与莲花破产重整分配的告知函》，要求莲花健康公司按照《重整计划》规定的清偿率向该行清偿。同日，国开行河南省分行向莲花健康公司管理人发出《要求参与莲花破产分配的告知函》，要求管理人履行管理人职责，协调莲花健康公司依照《重整计划》规定的清偿率向该行清偿；莲花健康公司管理人于2021年6月18日复函国开行河南省分行，称周口中院已裁定终结莲花健康公司重整程序，管理人监督职责已终止，告知国开行河南省分行可向莲花健康公司申报债权。

On June 11, 2021, the Henan Branch of China Development Bank issued a "Notice Requiring Participation in Distribution of Lotus Health's Bankruptcy Reorganization" to Lotus Health Company, demanding that Lotus Health Company satisfy the branch's claims at the repayment ratio specified in the Reorganization Plan. On the same day, the Henan Branch of China Development Bank also issued a "Notice Requiring Participation in Distribution of Lotus Health's Bankruptcy" to the administrator of Lotus Health Company, demanding that the administrator fulfill its duties and coordinate Lotus Health Company to satisfy the branch's claims at the repayment ratio specified in the Reorganization Plan. On June 18, 2021, the administrator of Lotus Health Company replied to the Henan Branch of China Development Bank, stating that the Zhoukou Intermediate People's Court had ruled to terminate the reorganization proceedings of Lotus Health Company, and the administrator's supervisory duties had ended, informing the Henan Branch that it could file claims with Lotus Health Company.

本院认为，根据国开行河南省分行的申诉理由，结合本案异议法院、复议法院的认定，本案应重点审查的问题是：（一）本案能否通过执行程序处理国开行河南省分行的债权？（二）本案国开行河南省分行的债权应按照何种条件清偿？针对上述争议问题，本院分析认定如下：

The Court holds that, based on the grounds for appeal of the Henan Branch of China Development Bank and in light of the determinations of the court of first instance and the court of reconsideration in this case, the issues to be reviewed are: (1) Whether the claim of the Henan Branch of China Development Bank in this case can be handled through enforcement proceedings; and (2) Under what conditions should the claim of the Henan Branch of China Development Bank in this case be satisfied? The Court analyzes and determines as follows regarding the above disputed issues:

（一）关于本案能否通过执行程序处理国开行河南省分行的债权的问题

(1) On the issue of whether the claim of the Henan Branch of China Development Bank in this case can be handled through enforcement proceedings

本案中，国开行河南省分行于2006年取得对莲花健康公司的胜诉判决，案件进入执行程序，执行法院周口中院在执行到位部分金额后于2009年裁定该案终结本次执行程序。2019年，周口中院裁定受理对莲花健康公司的重整申请以及批准莲花健康公司破产重整计划，莲花健康公司进入重整执行期间，至2020年4月30日重整计划执行完毕。在莲花健康公司破产重整程序过程中，并未通知国开行河南省分行申报债权，由此导致该分行的债权未能在破产重整程序中获得清偿。虽然《中华人民共和国企业破产法》第九十二条第二款规定：“债权人未依照本法规定申报债权的，在重整计划执行期间不得行使权利；在重整计划执行完毕后，可以按照重整计划规定的同类债权的清偿条件行使权利”，但该条未明确在破产程序中由于被执行人未通知已经进入执行程序的债权人申报债权而导致该债权人未在破产重整程序中申报债权及获得清偿，应通过何种程序保护该债权人的合法利益？

In this case, the Henan Branch of China Development Bank obtained a judgment in its favor against Lotus Health Company in 2006, and the case entered enforcement proceedings. The enforcement court, Zhoukou Intermediate People's Court, after recovering part of the amount, ruled to terminate the current enforcement proceedings in 2009. In 2019, Zhoukou Intermediate People's Court ruled to accept the reorganization application for Lotus Health Company and approved the bankruptcy reorganization plan of Lotus Health Company. Lotus Health Company entered the reorganization implementation period, and the reorganization plan was fully implemented by April 30, 2020. During the bankruptcy reorganization proceedings of Lotus Health Company, the Henan Branch was not notified to file its claims, resulting in its claims not being satisfied in the bankruptcy reorganization proceedings. Although Article 92, paragraph 2 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "A creditor that fails to file a claim in accordance with this Law may not exercise its rights during the period of implementation of the reorganization plan; after the implementation of the reorganization plan is completed, it may exercise its rights in accordance with the conditions for satisfaction of similar claims as provided in the reorganization plan," this provision does not specify the procedure through which the legitimate interests of a creditor who has not been notified by the enforcement debtor to file a claim in bankruptcy proceedings, and thus fails to file a claim and obtain satisfaction in the bankruptcy reorganization proceedings, should be protected.

对此，本院认为，就本案已经进入执行程序的债权人国开行河南省分行而言，针对莲花健康公司在本案破产重整程序中未通知其申报债权，由此导致国开行河南省分行失去在破产重整程序中主张债权的机会，对国开行河南省分行已经进入执行程序但未在破产程序中申报的债权，可通过执行程序处理。主要有以下几个方面的理由：

In this regard, the Court holds that, for the creditor Henan Branch of China Development Bank, whose claim has already entered enforcement proceedings, since Lotus Health Company failed to notify it to file a claim in the bankruptcy reorganization proceedings, thereby causing the Henan Branch to lose the opportunity to assert its claim in the bankruptcy reorganization proceedings, the claim of the Henan Branch that has entered enforcement proceedings but was not filed in the bankruptcy proceedings may be handled through enforcement proceedings. The main reasons are as follows:

首先，通过执行程序处理该未申报债权，与《中华人民共和国企业破产法》第九十二条第二款规定“债权人未依照本法规定申报债权的，在重整计划执行期间不得行使权利；在重整计划执行完毕后，可以按照重整计划规定的同类债权的清偿条件行使权利”的文义相符；就本条规定文义而言，“在重整计划执行完毕后，可以按照重整计划规定的同类债权的清偿条件行使权利”应解释适用于在重整计划执行完毕后，未申报债权但是已经进入执行程序的债权人，可以直接参照重整计划确定的同类债权清偿比例，请求执行法院通过执行程序保护其未获得清偿的债权。进一步，在该法律规定文义并未排除执行程序中直接适用的情况下，从有利于保护债权人利益和节约司法资源、提高司法效率角度，则应解释适用于执行程序之中的债权人利益保护。

First, handling the unfiled claim through enforcement proceedings is consistent with the literal meaning of Article 92, paragraph 2 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China, which provides: "A creditor that fails to file a claim in accordance with this Law may not exercise its rights during the period of implementation of the reorganization plan; after the implementation of the reorganization plan is completed, it may exercise its rights in accordance with the conditions for satisfaction of similar claims as provided in the reorganization plan." As to the literal meaning of this provision, "after the implementation of the reorganization plan is completed, it may exercise its rights in accordance with the conditions for satisfaction of similar claims as provided in the reorganization plan" should be interpreted as applicable to creditors who have not filed a claim but whose claim has already entered enforcement proceedings; such creditors may directly refer to the repayment ratio for similar claims as determined in the reorganization plan and request the enforcement court to protect their unsatisfied claims through enforcement proceedings. Furthermore, where the literal meaning of this legal provision does not preclude direct application in enforcement proceedings, from the perspective of protecting the interests of creditors and saving judicial resources and improving judicial efficiency, it should be interpreted as applicable to the protection of creditors' interests in enforcement proceedings.

其次，通过执行程序解决本案进入执行程序的债权人利益保护问题，有利于提高保护债权人利益的效率，避免本案债权人利益保护缺乏救济途径而影响其利益保护。针对终结本次执行程序的债权人，由于未被通知其申报债权而导致其未在破产重整程序中行使债权的情形，《中华人民共和国企业破产法》未规定其债权保护和救济方式，但是根据该法第四条关于“破产案件审理程序，本法没有规定的，适用民事诉讼法的有关规定”，则可以补充适用民事诉讼法有关规定、原则来处理。《中华人民共和国民事诉讼法》第八条规定，人民法院审理民事案件应当保障和便利当事人行使诉讼权利，故对于进入执行程序的债权人权利保护而言，执行工作在确定债权人行使权利的方式上亦应当注意保障和便利其依法行使权利。本案原审理破产重整案件的合议庭由于破产重整计划执行完毕，已经完成破产重整任务，往往以该破产案件结案处理；而破产管理人也由于破产重整计划执行完毕，其管理人任务已经完成，已不再具有相应职权。故向破产法院审判合议庭或者破产管理人请求行使权利，显然已经并无救济上的程序途径。在此情况下，强行要求债权人向原破产合议庭或破产管理人主张行使权利，则无异于徒然增加当事人行使权利的程序成本，而不会使其实体权益诉求得以实现。相反，案涉未清偿的债权在重整计划执行完毕后由执行法院通过恢复执行程序，按照《重整计划》所规定的债权清偿方式和比例予以保护，可使得债权人的权利得以直接实现，提高保护债权人利益的效率。

Second, resolving the issue of protecting the interests of the creditor whose claim has entered enforcement proceedings in this case through enforcement proceedings is beneficial to improving the efficiency of protecting creditors' interests and avoiding the situation where the creditor's interests lack relief channels, thereby affecting their protection. For a creditor whose current enforcement proceedings have been terminated, the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China does not provide for the protection and relief of its claim in the circumstance where it failed to exercise its claim in the bankruptcy reorganization proceedings due to lack of notification to file a claim. However, according to Article 4 of that Law, which provides: "For procedural matters not provided for in this Law in the trial of bankruptcy cases, the relevant provisions of the Civil Procedure Law shall apply," the relevant provisions and principles of the Civil Procedure Law may be applied supplementarily. Article 8 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides that when trying civil cases, the people's courts shall protect and facilitate the parties' exercise of their litigation rights. Therefore, for the protection of the rights of a creditor whose claim has entered enforcement proceedings, enforcement work should also pay attention to protecting and facilitating the creditor's exercise of its rights in accordance with the law when determining the manner in which the creditor may exercise its rights. In this case, the original collegiate panel that tried the bankruptcy reorganization case, having completed the task of bankruptcy reorganization upon the implementation of the reorganization plan, would typically close the case; and the bankruptcy administrator, also having completed its task upon the implementation of the reorganization plan, no longer has the corresponding authority. Therefore, seeking to exercise rights from the trial collegiate panel of the bankruptcy court or the bankruptcy administrator obviously has no procedural avenue for relief. Under such circumstances, forcing the creditor to assert its rights against the original bankruptcy collegiate panel or bankruptcy administrator would only increase the procedural costs for the party to exercise its rights without realizing its substantive claims. On the contrary, after the implementation of the reorganization plan is completed, the unsatisfied claim involved in this case can be protected by the enforcement court through resuming enforcement proceedings, in accordance with the claim satisfaction methods and ratios specified in the Reorganization Plan, thereby directly realizing the creditor's rights and improving the efficiency of protecting creditors' interests.

再次，由执行法院通过恢复执行程序处理，可以直接延续执行法院已开展的强制执行程序工作，节约司法资源，提高司法工作效率。本案中，债权人国开行河南省分行的债权已于2006年经生效判决确认，在债务人莲花健康公司在执行程序中清偿部分债权后，周口中院于2009年裁定终结本次执行程序。故案涉未清偿的债权属于已经法院生效判决确定并具有既判力的债权，已经不再具有再次审理和裁判的争议本质和法理基础。因此，对于该已经生效判决所确定并已经进入执行程序的债权，已经基于强制执行程序而属于具有强制执行效力的债权；对于该已启动强制执行程序的债权，执行法院对相关债权已经基于强制执行而获得清偿的债权数额及未获清偿的债权数额，已经基于执行案件而建立案件账目，且最为清楚；故由该执行法院恢复执行，有利于其及时高效计算债权人未获清偿债权的具体数额，在体现保护债权人利益工作延续性基础上，提高执行案件的执行效率；而通过在执行程序中直接按照破产重整计划确定的条件清偿未获得清偿部分的债权，则可以避免让已经完成破产重整程序任务的破产审判合议庭和破产管理人重新启动工作，增加不必要的工作负担，进而有利于节约司法资源。

Third, handling the matter through resumption of enforcement proceedings by the enforcement court directly continues the enforcement work already undertaken by the enforcement court, saving judicial resources and improving judicial efficiency. In this case, the claim of the creditor Henan Branch of China Development Bank was already confirmed by a final judgment in 2006. After the debtor Lotus Health Company satisfied part of the claim during enforcement proceedings, Zhoukou Intermediate People's Court ruled to terminate the current enforcement proceedings in 2009. Therefore, the unsatisfied claim involved in this case is a claim that has been determined by a final judgment of the court and has res judicata effect, and no longer has the essence of a dispute or legal basis for re-trial and adjudication. Consequently, the claim that has been determined by a final judgment and has entered enforcement proceedings is a claim with compulsory enforcement effect based on compulsory enforcement proceedings; as to this claim for which compulsory enforcement proceedings have been initiated, the enforcement court has established case accounts based on the enforcement case, which most clearly show the amount of the claim that has been satisfied through compulsory enforcement and the amount that remains unsatisfied. Therefore, having this enforcement court resume enforcement is conducive to its timely and efficient calculation of the specific amount of the creditor's unsatisfied claim, improving the efficiency of enforcement cases on the basis of reflecting the continuity of protecting creditors' interests. Moreover, directly satisfying the unsatisfied portion of the claim in enforcement proceedings in accordance with the conditions determined in the bankruptcy reorganization plan avoids restarting the work of the bankruptcy trial collegiate panel and bankruptcy administrator that have already completed the bankruptcy reorganization tasks, thereby avoiding unnecessary workloads and saving judicial resources.

此种处理方式除适用于本案执行案件实施部门和破产案件审理合议庭属于同一法院的情形外，还适用于执行案件实施法院和债务人破产案件审理法院非同一法院的类似情形；即如果由于通知义务主体未通知执行案件债权人被执行人已经进入破产程序的事实，导致该执行案件债权人的债权在破产程序中未获得保护，则执行法院亦可参照上述程序处理，通过恢复执行程序处理，以实现裁判标准统一。

This approach applies not only to the situation where the enforcement division and the collegiate panel handling the bankruptcy case belong to the same court, as in this case, but also to similar situations where the enforcement court and the court handling the debtor's bankruptcy case are different. That is, if the failure of the party with the obligation to notify to inform the enforcement case creditor of the fact that the enforcement debtor has entered bankruptcy proceedings results in the enforcement case creditor's claim not being protected in the bankruptcy proceedings, the enforcement court may also handle the matter by reference to the above procedure through resumption of enforcement proceedings, so as to achieve uniformity in adjudicative standards.

（二）关于本案国开行河南省分行的债权应按照何种条件清偿的问题

(2) On the issue of the conditions under which the claim of the Henan Branch of China Development Bank in this case should be satisfied

针对本案由于破产程序相关通知义务主体未通知执行案件债权人、导致执行案件债权人未通过破产重整程序申报的债权，由执行法院通过执行程序处理，则涉及人民法院在执行程序中如何执行的问题，即执行法院应按照何种条件保障该债权的执行问题。对此，本院认为，《中华人民共和国企业破产法》第九十二条第一款的规定，经人民法院裁定批准的重整计划，对债务人和全体债权人均有约束力，该规定当然能够适用于本案国开行河南省分行的情形，故针对国开行河南省分行已经进入执行程序但未获强制执行清偿的剩余债权，可以直接按照重整计划确定的清偿方案强制执行获得清偿。且就本案的事实而言，本案《重整计划》之四（三）2明确：“未申报债权，对于莲花健康公司账面记载但未依法申报的债权，如债权权利应受法律保护的，在本重整计划执行期间不得行使权利，但可以在重整计划执行完毕后要求莲花健康公司按照重整计划中规定的同类债权清偿方案进行清偿”，故该《重整计划》亦明确了可按照《重整计划》同类债权清偿方案清偿。故就本案国开行河南省分行所享有的、已经进入执行程序但未依照《中华人民共和国企业破产法》规定申报的债权，在莲花健康公司重整计划执行完毕后，债权人国开行河南省分行可以按照《重整计划》规定的同类债权的清偿条件行使权利。

As to the claim in this case that was not filed in the bankruptcy reorganization proceedings due to the failure of the party with the obligation to notify in the bankruptcy proceedings to inform the enforcement case creditor, which is to be handled by the enforcement court through enforcement proceedings, the question arises as to how the people's court should enforce it in the enforcement proceedings, i.e., under what conditions should the enforcement court ensure the enforcement of this claim? In this regard, the Court holds that Article 92, paragraph 1 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China provides that a reorganization plan approved by a people's court is binding on both the debtor and all creditors. This provision is certainly applicable to the situation of the Henan Branch of China Development Bank in this case. Therefore, as to the remaining claim of the Henan Branch that has entered enforcement proceedings but has not been satisfied through compulsory enforcement, it can be directly enforced and satisfied in accordance with the satisfaction plan determined in the reorganization plan. Moreover, as to the facts of this case, Section 4(3)2 of the Reorganization Plan clearly provides: "For unfiled claims, i.e., claims recorded in Lotus Health Company's books but not filed in accordance with the law, if the rights under the claims should be protected by law, they may not be exercised during the implementation period of this reorganization plan, but may, after the implementation of the reorganization plan is completed, require Lotus Health Company to satisfy them in accordance with the satisfaction plan for similar claims provided in this reorganization plan." Therefore, the Reorganization Plan also clarifies that satisfaction may be made in accordance with the satisfaction plan for similar claims under the Reorganization Plan. Accordingly, as to the claim of the Henan Branch of China Development Bank in this case, which has entered enforcement proceedings but was not filed in accordance with the provisions of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China, after the implementation of Lotus Health Company's reorganization plan is completed, the creditor Henan Branch of China Development Bank may exercise its rights in accordance with the conditions for satisfaction of similar claims provided in the Reorganization Plan.

至于本案恢复执行之后，是否存在国开行河南省分行免除莲花健康公司债务的问题。鉴于本案周口中院、河南高院在异议、复议程序中均从本案不应通过执行程序处理的角度进行审查，并认定本案不应通过恢复执行程序处理，而未对是否存在国开行河南省分行免除莲花健康公司债务的问题进行审理。如针对国开行河南省分行是否存在免除莲花健康公司债务的实体问题，则本院原则上应将本案发回周口中院重新审理。但是，本院从明确法律适用标准、提高审判效率、节约司法资源角度出发，在明确本案应通过恢复执行程序处理案涉法律适用问题的情况下，不将本案发回重审，而是直接对周口中院、河南高院法律适用错误予以纠正。在该处理模式下，莲花健康公司仍可依据《最高人民法院关于人民法院办理执行异议和复议案件若干问题的规定》第七条第二款“被执行人以债权消灭、丧失强制执行效力等执行依据生效之后的实体事由提出排除执行异议的，人民法院应当参照民事诉讼法第二百二十五条规定进行审查”的规定，依法就是否存在国开行河南省分行免除其债务的问题向执行法院请求救济；如莲花健康公司提出该异议请求救济，则异议法院可在本案恢复执行的前提下，聚焦该焦点问题进行审理，从而节约司法资源、提高司法效率，进而提高保护合法权利人利益的效率。

As to whether, after the resumption of enforcement in this case, there is an issue of the Henan Branch of China Development Bank discharging Lotus Health Company's debt. Given that in the objection and reconsideration proceedings, the Zhoukou Intermediate People's Court and the Henan High People's Court reviewed the case from the perspective that it should not be handled through enforcement proceedings and determined that it should not be handled through resumption of enforcement proceedings, and did not try the issue of whether the Henan Branch of China Development Bank discharged Lotus Health Company's debt. If the substantive issue of whether the Henan Branch of China Development Bank discharged Lotus Health Company's debt were to be addressed, this Court would, in principle, remand the case to the Zhoukou Intermediate People's Court for retrial. However, from the perspective of clarifying the legal application standards, improving trial efficiency, and saving judicial resources, and under the circumstances where it is clear that the legal application issue in this case should be handled through resumption of enforcement proceedings, this Court will not remand the case for retrial, but will directly correct the errors in legal application made by the Zhoukou Intermediate People's Court and the Henan High People's Court. Under this handling approach, Lotus Health Company may still, in accordance with Article 7, paragraph 2 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Handling of Objections to Enforcement and Reconsideration Cases by People's Courts, which provides: "Where an enforcement party raises an objection to exclude enforcement on substantive grounds such as extinguishment of the claim or loss of compulsory enforcement effect that arise after the enforcement title takes effect, the people's court shall review the matter by reference to Article 225 of the Civil Procedure Law," lawfully seek relief from the enforcement court on the issue of whether the Henan Branch of China Development Bank discharged its debt. If Lotus Health Company raises such an objection and seeks relief, the objection court may, on the premise that enforcement in this case has been resumed, focus its trial on this pivotal issue, thereby saving judicial resources, improving judicial efficiency, and enhancing the efficiency of protecting the interests of legitimate rights holders.

综上，周口中院（2021）豫16执异40号执行裁定撤销该院（2021）豫16执恢20号恢复执行通知书；河南高院作出（2021）豫执复339号执行裁定，裁定驳回国开行河南省分行复议申请、维持周口中院（2021）豫16执异40号异议裁定，均适用法律错误，应予纠正；本院依据《中华人民共和国企业破产法》第九十二条、《中华人民共和国民事诉讼法》第二百一十一条、《最高人民法院关于人民法院执行工作若干问题的规定（试行）》第71条的规定，裁定如下：

In summary, the enforcement ruling of the Zhoukou Intermediate People's Court (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Yi No. 40, which set aside the court's (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Hui No. 20 Notice of Resumption of Enforcement, and the enforcement ruling of the Henan High People's Court (2021) Yu Zhi Fu No. 339, which rejected the reconsideration application of the Henan Branch of China Development Bank and upheld the objection ruling (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Yi No. 40 of the Zhoukou Intermediate People's Court, both contain errors in legal application and should be corrected. Pursuant to Article 92 of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 211 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and Article 71 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Work of People's Courts in Enforcement (for Trial Implementation), this Court rules as follows:

一、撤销河南省高级人民法院（2021）豫执复339号执行裁定；

1. The enforcement ruling (2021) Yu Zhi Fu No. 339 of the Henan High People's Court is set aside;

二、撤销河南省周口市中级人民法院（2021）豫16执异40号执行裁定。

2. The enforcement ruling (2021) Yu 16 Zhi Yi No. 40 of the Zhoukou Intermediate People's Court of Henan Province is set aside.
